mottosOrTextOverlays.text: PERFORM
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Visible on kit/tattoo; potential voice/brand motif if Michele uses it publicly. Confirm before making it a headline.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: THIS ISN'T JUST A FITNESS JOURNEY
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Large overlaid headline from her own post; strong candidate for a quote/motto treatment, pending exact-copy approval.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: It's how I rebuilt my life from the ground up
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Visible supporting line from the same post; powerful bio/community-voice material.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: From lost and lonely, to confident and capable, to leading a global Hyrox community
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Visible caption text; captures the emotional arc and Hyrox Newbies/community positioning.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Battled SLE with severe renal involvement in my twenties
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Sensitive health disclosure; approval required before reuse.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Loved science and trained as a biomedical scientist, but couldn't cope working for the NHS
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Biographical background; useful for credibility/context but verify exact wording.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Lost who I was in the chaos of illness, young motherhood, and loneliness
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Sensitive personal/family/health line; approval required before reuse.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Started with yoga and fitness classes post babies... just wanting to do something for me
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Origin story line; consider smoothing grammar only if Michele approves.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: One transformation changed everything
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Short powerful line; usable as a motif if she approves the surrounding context.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Being fit and capable gave me confidence to leave a toxic relationship and step into my true self
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Sensitive relationship disclosure; approval required before reuse.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Decided to quit my job in biomedical sciences. Qualified as a PT. Met my wife and built Wilder Fitness together.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Business-origin line; check whether wife/partner should appear in public-facing pitch copy.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Helping people transform their bodies and lives
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Strong direct coaching/community line; lower sensitivity than the personal disclosures.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Pushed my body to the extreme. Looked my best... but felt my worst.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Excellent sustainable-coaching angle; sensitive body-image context requires care.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Hyrox is a puzzle. The only way to figure it out is to race.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Client-story quote attributed to Michael's story; use only with approval because the surrounding post includes sensitive health details.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: He smashed his PB by 14 minutes — 1:31:05
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Client result claim; verify permission and exact wording before using as a success story.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Official HYROX coach. Hybrid athlete specialist. Founder of Hyrox Newbies. Leading the hybrid fitness community movement.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Public positioning/credential stack; useful for hero or bio copy after date/source check.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: This is my journey. And now, I help others write theirs.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Best current motto candidate: concise, authentic and directly bridges personal journey to coaching/community.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Coached 100+ athletes over 3 seasons. Created Hyrox Newbies community now 70,000+ strong.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Credential/community claim from September 2025 screenshot; check for a newer number before using.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Then my coach said... try HYROX. 12 weeks later, I raced. Finished in 1:23. And I was hooked on performance over aesthetics.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Strong origin line; first-person caption confirms it is Michele's own stated first-race story.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: YOU DON'T NEED A HYROX RACE BOOKED TO START TRAINING
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Foundations headline; strong beginner-onboarding hook for a programme card or homepage banner.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: This is what an off-season can do.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Coaching-method hook; pairs with the longer process caption about aerobic base, threshold and strength.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: We're not trying to suddenly get Gary fit now. We're teaching him to use the fitness he's spent months building.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Excellent periodisation/coaching-intelligence line; lower sensitivity because it describes method, not private details.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Please don't wait until you can "run properly" before you start training for HYROX.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Welcoming objection-buster; strong beginner/community tone for Foundations-style messaging.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: But where you are now is your starting point.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Clean, low-risk motivational line; usable almost anywhere.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Foundations II — 8 weeks, £175 or £99 pay in two; no race booked needed
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Real programme structure/pricing from a 3 October post; useful for shaping her offer card, but verify current cohort before publishing.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Build the athlete first. Then make the athlete specific.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Signature coaching-philosophy line; strong candidate for a coaching-methods headline.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: I can write the best programme in the world, but it only works if the person on the other end commits to executing it
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Honest coach-athlete partnership line; good for expectations/onboarding copy.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: Every session should have a purpose. And a HYROX sim has to earn its place just like everything else.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Strong anti-junk-volume positioning; pairs the 'why are we doing it?' question with a clear principle.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: There's a difference between practising HYROX and building the qualities that make you good at HYROX.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Excellent expertise-signalling line; distinguishes smart coaching from just doing more HYROX.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: We're not coaching people just to complete one particular race. We're trying to help them become better athletes.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Big-picture coaching ethos line; great fit for a coaching-page header or about section.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: HYROX season 26/27 we are still coming for ya!!
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Defiant/resilient line BUT attached to a sensitive health-disclosure post — do not use without explicit approval.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: One of the best things has got to be the new friendships that I've gained through Head Judging.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Confirms her Head Judge role in her own words — combine with the credential: 'HYROX Head Judge + official coach + Hyrox Newbies founder' is a very strong credibility stack.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: MY SPORT IS. YOUR SPORT IS. OUR SPORT IS. HYROX.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: HYROX's own event-wall slogan she poses beneath — ideal belonging/community framing and it literally sits behind her in the photo.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: HYROX isn't a 5k fun run you can just wing. It's a very specific beast. Training for it = strategy.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Educational/authority voice; good seed for 'how long to train' guidance content.

mottosOrTextOverlays.text: This season, as a coach, has filled me to the brim — with pride, with emotion, with purpose, with joy.
mottosOrTextOverlays.note: Warm season-reflection line; strong candidate for a coach-quote panel or about page.
